words.gloss: being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits
words.discriminator: visibly sunny mood, no special reason needed
a burst of joy at something that just happened

words.gloss: pleased about something you or someone close to you managed to do
glad because a worry turned out all right
words.discriminator: the bad thing did not happen
thankful to someone for what they did

contrasts.line: Cheerful is a sunny mood without a special cause. Delighted is a burst after an exciting event.
Cheerful looks bright and upbeat. Proud is about an achievement.
Cheerful is sunny for no special reason. Relieved means a bad thing did not happen.
Cheerful is a bright mood. Grateful is thanks for help from another person.
Delighted is a sudden burst after an event. Cheerful is a steady sunny mood.
Delighted reacts to happy news or a surprise. Proud comes from achievement.
Delighted jumps up at a fun event. Relieved relaxes when danger or trouble passes.
Delighted is joy at what happened. Grateful is thanks for what a person did.
Proud means happy about achievement. Cheerful just means sunny in mood.
Proud is about work or achievement. Delighted is a burst from an exciting event.
Proud stands tall after achievement. Relieved relaxes after a scare ends safely.
Proud is joy in achievement. Grateful is thanks for help from another person.
Relieved means the feared bad thing did not happen. Cheerful is simply sunny.
Relieved comes after a scare ends safely. Delighted comes after exciting news.
Relieved is about danger passing. Proud is about achievement.
Relieved says trouble is over. Grateful says thanks for another person's help.
Grateful means thankful for help. Cheerful means bright and sunny in mood.
Grateful thanks a helper. Delighted bursts with joy at an event.
Grateful is thanks for help. Proud is happiness about achievement.
Grateful thanks a helper. Relieved relaxes when a feared problem is gone.
